record.title: Customs Tariff Commission Announcement No. 4 (2025) on imposing additional tariffs on imported goods originating in the United States
record.issuer: Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council (CTC)
record.relation_note: Original additional duty 34%; raised by Nos. 5 and 6 (84%, 125%), brought back by No. 7 to 10% with 24 percentage points suspended, and the suspension continued by No. 8, No. 10 and No. 6 (2026); the operative status in force is: 10% retained, 24 percentage points suspended until 10 Jan 2027 (split in measures B1-TAR-11/12)
record.note: The original 34% clause was checked against the MOF English-edition text; the subsequent rate chain is consistent across multiple official republications; the row is graded B overall.
